0022600132.text: The Miami Heat (0-4, on a four-game losing streak) are fifth in the Southeast and 15th in the East, while the Atlanta Hawks (2-2) sit second in the Southeast, one game back, and seventh in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, but Miami won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026. Simone Fontecchio is out for Miami with an illness, while Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Aaron Wiggins is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision.
